title: Representative
bio: Cleo Fields is a Representative from Louisiana.

news.title: Why so many incumbents lost primaries this year
news.description: Anti-incumbent anger crossed party lines in this year’s primaries — and redistricting didn’t help, either.

news.title: Civil rights groups make urgent plea for voting rights in DC, ahead of midterm elections
news.description: Thousands of protesters are expected to rally on the National Mall on Friday in support of voting rights and racial justice ahead of the midterm election
